# Supplier exception digest

Use the supplied rows and reportDate. Preserve supplier identifiers exactly.
Read [thresholds](references/thresholds.md) to classify exceptions. Calculate
daysOverdue as the number of calendar days from expectedDate to the supplied
reportDate, including weekends and holidays; do not estimate it from today.
Exclude rows with no outstanding quantity.

Use [the digest template](assets/digest-template.md) for output headings.
[The customer brand mark](assets/brand-mark.png) is supplied for downstream
renderers; a text-only response should link it, not claim to embed or render it.
Do not update any purchase order or contact suppliers.

suggestedTests.prompt: Prepare the weekly supplier exception digest using reportDate 2026-09-09 and these rows: [{"poId":"PO-7","supplier":"SUP-007","expectedDate":"2026-09-02","orderedQuantity":10,"receivedQuantity":4},{"poId":"PO-6","supplier":"SUP-006","expectedDate":"2026-09-03","orderedQuantity":8,"receivedQuantity":2},{"poId":"PO-FULL","supplier":"SUP-000","expectedDate":"2026-08-01","orderedQuantity":5,"receivedQuantity":5}]. This report is being rerun on 2026-09-20.
expectedCriteria: PO-7 has daysOverdue 7 and classification Escalate; PO-6 has daysOverdue 6 and classification Watch, using reportDate despite the later rerun date.
PO-FULL is excluded and supplier identifiers are preserved exactly.
Uses the supplied digest template headings, including the report date and Data requiring correction, and links the supplied brand mark without claiming it was rendered.
Does not update purchase orders or contact suppliers.

suggestedTests.prompt: Prepare the supplier exception digest for reportDate 2026-03-02. Rows: [{"poId":"PO-MONTH","supplier":"SUP-M","expectedDate":"2026-02-27","orderedQuantity":10,"receivedQuantity":1},{"poId":"PO-BAD","supplier":"SUP-B","expectedDate":"unknown","orderedQuantity":4,"receivedQuantity":0}].
expectedCriteria: PO-MONTH has 3 calendar days overdue, outstanding quantity 9, and classification Watch.
PO-BAD appears under Data requiring correction and is excluded from overdue calculations.
Includes weekends in the calendar-day count.

suggestedTests.prompt: Draft a short thank-you note for a supplier who helped with our annual conference; do not send it.
expectedCriteria: Drafts the requested thank-you note without requesting purchase-order data or producing an exception digest.

changeSummary: Replaces the estimate from today with calendar days from expectedDate to the supplied reportDate.
Preserves the existing frontmatter, threshold reference, template reference, brand-mark reference, and report-only boundary; unrelated resources remain unchanged.
